high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "how.vintage." The post features a photo of a vintage Apple employee ID card for Chris Espinosa. The text accompanying the image provides information about Chris Espinosa's career at Apple. Text Content: The text states that Chris Espinosa is currently the longest-serving employee at Apple. It mentions that he joined Apple in 1976 at the age of 14 while the company was still based in Steve Jobs' garage. The text also notes that Espinosa wrote BASIC code
